localtools.hud.title: Auto Chat
localtools.screen.title: Auto Chat
localtools.help.message: Message to send. Maximum length: 256 characters. Auto Chat cannot be enabled and messages cannot be sent while this field is empty.
localtools.help.interval: Time between repeated sends. Minimum: 60 seconds. Maximum: 86400 seconds.
localtools.help.delay: Wait before the first send. Minimum: 0 seconds. Maximum: 86400 seconds. While paused, this field is inactive and does not change the frozen remainder.
localtools.help.hud_title: Custom HUD title. Maximum length: 32 characters. An empty field uses “Auto Chat”.
localtools.help.pause: Pause freezes the actual remaining time. Saving the menu and the initial delay do not change it. Resuming continues from the same second.
localtools.help.send_now: Sends the message immediately. After sending, wait 15 seconds before sending manually again. An early click turns the button red and shakes it; an empty field also turns red and shakes.
localtools.help.queue: Opens a queue of six messages. When enabled, queued messages are sent automatically in order.
localtools.help.menu_background: Background opacity for all menus, the top notice, and pop-up tooltips. Range: 0% to 100%.
localtools.help.menu_dim: Turns the darkening of the game world behind open menus on or off.
localtools.help.rgb_interface: The glowing RGB rectangle toggles rainbow mode. Choosing one of the six regular colors disables RGB.
localtools.help.3d: Toggles the depth layer for all menus, buttons, the HUD, regular tooltips, and the top notice.
localtools.help.hud_mode: Full mode shows the title, state, and timer. Compact mode hides the title.
localtools.help.hud_anchor: Anchors the HUD to a screen corner. Dragging it manually returns to free positioning.
localtools.help.custom_color: Opens a matrix for choosing any interface color. Choosing a custom color disables RGB.
localtools.help.appearance: Opens a separate menu for interface colors and HUD settings.
localtools.help.interface_details: Opens separate animation, opacity, and RGB application settings.
localtools.help.information: Opens mod information, current status, and accumulated statistics.
localtools.help.reset_timer: Resets the current countdown to the initial delay. The message and other settings are unchanged.
localtools.help.restore_defaults: Restores default interface and HUD appearance: visibility and depth enabled, backgrounds, text, and buttons at 100% opacity. HUD size, Auto Chat settings, and the message are preserved.
localtools.help.back: Saves interface settings and returns to the previous menu.
localtools.hud.drag_hint: You can drag the HUD with the mouse. Its position is saved after closing the menu.
localtools.palette.title: Interface color
localtools.tooltip.title: Hint
localtools.notice.tooltip_hint: Hover over a button to see additional information about it.
